note: Known-findings baseline for the bare numbered-CEC rule (CEC_BARE_NUMBER in scripts/check-iicrc-compliance.mjs), pinned 2026-11-21 when the rule landed. These entries are NOT approvals. Each pins one pre-existing line by exact (file, normalised text) so the guard reports it every run for the founder while the rule stays ENFORCED for every other line. A new or changed line blocks; an entry whose line is gone also blocks, so this list only shrinks. Never add an entry to make a new claim pass: record the IICRC approval (data/seed/cec-approvals.json), add a reviewed requirement-fact line to scripts/iicrc-cec-allowlist.json, or remove the number. `line` is informational only.
